爱莎贝儿-148CM-L 粉肤 RAD008 最上希海Mogami Nozomi-手心的温度
碰到他嘴唇时，她膝盖一软。本来说好数到三就停，现在却变成他轻扶她后颈的十秒。
两人退开后，谁都不敢先开口，只听见练习稿沙沙滑落。
由话剧排练变成假戏真做~就让排练继续下去吧。
身型：148CM-L 粉肤

Elsa Babe-148CM-L Pink RAD008 Mogami Nozomi-The Warmth of His Palm
Her knees buckled when her lips touched his. They had agreed to count to three and stop, but now it turned into ten seconds of him gently supporting the back of her neck.
After they stepped back, neither dared to speak first, only the rustling of the script falling to the floor could be heard.
From play rehearsal to real life~ Let the rehearsal continue.
Body type: 148CM-L with Pink skin tone.
